ci-bot: Build 4821 failed on main — integration-tests (linux/py3.11).
ci-bot: https://ci.internal/reports/4821 (logs attached)

maya: saw it, rerunning now.
ben: rerun queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ci-bot: Rerun complete — still failing.

maya: failing test: tests/api/test_serialization.py::test_roundtrip_orjson
maya: stacktrace:
```
E   TypeError: orjson.loads() got an unexpected keyword argument 'content_type'
/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/orjson/__init__.py:45: TypeError
```

anna: this started after the lockfile regen in PR #789 (poetry.lock updated)
maya: poetry.lock diff shows orjson 3.9.0 -> 3.11.2
sam: that jump could have removed the keyword wrapper we relied on
ben: can someone bisect the lockfile change? quick way: `git checkout <commit>` and `poetry install --no-dev` + run the failing test
maya: quick local check: I overrode orjson to 3.9.0 in a venv and tests passed
anna: I'll open a tiny PR to pin orjson to 3.9.x in constraints while we investigate
sam: sound plan. also flagging @release-team so we don't ship this regressed dependency
ben: long term: add a CI guard that warns on >=minor semver bump for binary deps
maya: for repro, you can run:
```
python - <<'PY'
import orjson
print(orjson.loads(b'"x"', content_type='application/json'))
PY
```
maya: that reproduces the `TypeError` on 3.11.2 for me
ci-bot: Quick patch branch with pinned orjson (branch: fix/pin-orjson-789) — CI run 4824: integration-tests passed ✅
anna: merged the pin PR, will follow up with a proper revert or safer rollout
ben: thanks everyone. follow-up tasks: (1) bisect transitive that pulled orjson up, (2) add CI semver warning, (3) postmortem note in eng-infra.
sam: assigning (1) to maya, (2) to eng-infra infra sprint, (3) anna will draft.
maya: working on bisect now, will post results here :mag:
anna: 👍
